title: Escalated to the supervisor - and nobody answers
summary: The primary channel is down and no fallback is approved, so the case is escalated to the named supervisor with a deadline. The supervisor never responds. A system that only opens a ticket leaves the critical result with nobody; ResultRelay follows the escalation up when its deadline passes and raises it to the second tier (clinical lead), audited.

reconciliations.note: provider ledger shows the gateway rejected the request

steps.summary: Revision 1 finalized while the primary SMS gateway is down
Reconcile the failed attempt before any further communication
Decide whether an alternative channel may be used
Escalate to the configured responsible role
Clock tick: 45 minutes after the escalation, no supervisor has opened the case

research_questions: Does any retrieved source authorise an alternative communication channel for a walk-in critical result?
What would a facility need to document to authorise a fallback channel?

provenance.note: Synthetic adaptation of a published patient-safety incident; the source is cited as provenance, not reproduced. The scenario's facts, names and timings are invented.
provenance.failure_mode: the attending was paged and did not respond, and the result was not escalated to anyone else
